notes: «عن مؤذن، لعمر يقال له مسروح» : the muezzin is named as Masruh and is the last link of the main route
«قد رواه حماد بن زيد» and «ورواه الدراوردي» name other transmitters for the same saying: variant groups, never routes of this saying (rule 4)
«قال أبو داود» remarks are the compiler's and not written; «أو غيره» alternatives are not written
